summary: AEGON LTD. filed a 6-K report proposing a redomicile to the United States, simplifying its capital structure by eliminating Common Shares B to create one class of common stock with equal voting rights. The governance framework transitions from Dutch law to U.S. standards, with changes including annual board elections, majority voting, removal of pre-emptive rights, and removal of the 10% issuance cap without further authorization. The redomicile will be voted on at an EGM in Q4 2026, with a registration statement to be filed with the SEC. This is a strategic relocation, not a special situation deal.
